text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-sama. If it is no trouble, could 
you tell me what kind of performance art 
you like?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, I wanted to expand my 
repertoire of banquet tricks for the 
Yukoma Inn♪

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
If we satisfy many guests, it leads to 
word-of-mouth and repeat visits, wouldn't 
you say?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
I've mastered classic performances like 
the Nanjing bamboo screen, plate spinning, 
pantomime, and stand-up comedy—so next, 
I'd like to explore even newer frontiers!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Our goal is Pyoi-tastic prosperity! Flocks 
of customers♪ So please, do share your 
thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's bath basin juggling or heavy 
metal Bon Odori dancing, I'm ready to 
challenge absolutely anything♪
